rows.title: Town Gate
rows.blurb: A timber gate in a palisade of sharpened logs. A plank watchtower, a kettle on the fire, dice on a stump.

rows.title: Lowtown Green
rows.blurb: A muddy green ringed by timber houses with sagging thatch. Washing lines, ducks in the ditch, a barrow of vegetables.

rows.title: Tavern Common Room
rows.blurb: Smoke-black timber beams, a roaring hearth, long tables scarred by knives.

rows.title: Tavern Guest Rooms
rows.blurb: A narrow hall of plank doors with chalked numbers. Muffled voices and a floorboard creak somewhere ahead.

rows.title: Tavern Cellar
rows.blurb: Rough-cut steps, ale casks, damp lime. Something scrabbles behind the racks.

rows.title: Odds and Ends
rows.blurb: A stone-fronted shop with a bow window. Inside, narrow aisles between teetering shelves — rope, pots, oddments stacked to the rafters.

rows.title: Red Anvil
rows.blurb: A granite forge-house with an iron sign. Heat hits you at the door.

rows.title: Shrine of the Dawnmother
rows.blurb: Cool dressed stone, candles, coloured light through a saint-glass window.

rows.title: Hayward's Stables
rows.blurb: Stone stalls under slate, brass name plates on every door. Warm horses, swallows in the rafters; polished tack hangs on pegs.

rows.title: Archery Range
rows.blurb: A walled lawn behind Hightown — straw butts, painted targets, a rope line.

rows.title: Graveyard
rows.blurb: Wooden grave markers leaning in the mud behind Lowtown, a few mossy stones, yew trees, a crooked iron fence.

rows.title: Crypt
rows.blurb: Cold steps, bone niches, one great stone sarcophagus. Dead candles crumble underfoot.

rows.title: Mayor's House
rows.blurb: Ivy-clad stone, a clipped garden, polished oak inside. Portraits of fat ancestors line the hall.

rows.title: Town Jail
rows.blurb: Stone cells under the town hall, mouldy straw, a dozing jailer and a bold rat.

rows.title: Hightown Plaza
rows.blurb: Flagstones swept clean, a carved fountain, tall houses of dressed grey stone with glazed windows.

rows.title: Old Bridge
rows.blurb: A humped stone bridge over the brown river. Downstream, timber jetties and fishing boats; upstream, the stone walls of Hightown climb the hill.

rows.title: Docks
rows.blurb: Tarred timber jetties on stilts, nets drying on racks, gulls fighting over fish guts.

rows.title: Woods Edge
rows.blurb: Cart ruts run through the near trees. South, the cart track runs back through cleared ground to the town gate.

rows.title: Wrecked Cart
rows.blurb: An overturned iron cart, a dead ox, and goblin prints in the mud. Colossal mushroom stems rise beyond the ruts.

rows.title: Pip's Hiding Tree
rows.blurb: A hollow oak; flour on the bark. Someone whimpers above.

rows.title: Hanging Doe
rows.blurb: A doe hangs in pale silk between two trunks, still warm. One haunch is cut and waiting.

rows.title: Poacher's Cache
rows.blurb: A hide scraped under the roots. A wire shines across the opening.

rows.title: Mushroom Hollow
rows.blurb: Towering giant mushrooms ring a sunny hollow. Grey caps crowd the floor; the air smells of loam and rain.

rows.title: Troll Bridge
rows.blurb: A rope bridge sags over a black gorge. Something grunts underneath.

rows.title: Far Side
rows.blurb: The gorge ends on a high shelf of grey stone. Wind tears at your cloak.

rows.title: Mother Sedge's Hut
rows.blurb: A crooked hut on stilts. Herbs dry on the eaves; a pot bubbles.

rows.title: Witch's Cellar
rows.blurb: Damp steps, jars on shelves. One jar holds a toad with human eyes.

rows.title: Old Shrine
rows.blurb: A cracked sun disc leans in ivy. Warm light pulses once, then waits.

rows.title: Fairy Fountain
rows.blurb: A glowing spring in a mossy bowl. The water is warm and utterly still.

rows.title: Guard Tunnel
rows.blurb: Two goblins slump against the walls, jugs in their laps. The stone is cut square, older than they are.

rows.title: Mushroom Farm
rows.blurb: Glowing caps in dung beds.

rows.title: Brewery
rows.blurb: Copper vats bubble in a dwarven winch-frame. Pick heads are nailed on as taps.

rows.title: Mess Hall
rows.blurb: Long tables, shouting goblins, barrels rolling underfoot. They drink from cracked mining helmets.

rows.title: Cask Cellar
rows.blurb: Ore carts hold the casks. The rails run into the dark and stop.

rows.title: Brewmaster's Throne
rows.blurb: A throne of kegs. A bloated goblin chief drains a brass hose.

rows.title: Prisoner Pens
rows.blurb: Wooden cages. Two humans watch you through the slats.

rows.title: Loot Pile
rows.blurb: Stolen iron, town goods, and coin heaped behind the throne.

rows.title: Spore Pit
rows.blurb: Pale fungus breathes up from a pit. The air tastes like copper.

rows.title: Shaman's Den
rows.blurb: A wizened goblin in a mushroom hat mutters over a brazier.

rows.title: Underground River
rows.blurb: A black river slides through the stone. Barrels spin in the current.

rows.title: Goblin Lookout
rows.blurb: A rope ladder climbs to a platform on the limestone. A bronze horn hangs on a peg.

rows.title: Goblin Cave Mouth
rows.blurb: A mossy bank cave. Bones on stakes grin at the path.

rows.title: Tide Cave
rows.blurb: The black river comes out under a lip of kelp and wet stone. A goblin grate rusts in the flow.

rows.title: Wreck of the Penny
rows.blurb: A fishing boat sits high on the rocks, stern already in the swell. The name Penny is still gold on the bow.

rows.title: Penny's Hold
rows.blurb: The deck sags. Wet rope holds a man to a ring bolt.

rows.title: Scree Stair
rows.blurb: Loose stone stairs drop a cliff. Every step shifts.

rows.title: Old Mine Head
rows.blurb: A rusted cage hangs in a dwarven shaft. The winch is wrapped in copper pipe.

rows.title: Lonely Shore
rows.blurb: Black sand, reeds, and a still reach of water. A wooded islet sits north.

rows.title: Rowboat Crossing
rows.blurb: A creaking rowboat ties to a stump. One oar, a coiled line, cold water over the gunwales.

rows.title: Lonely House Island
rows.blurb: One house, shutters barred from inside. The step is swept.

rows.title: Northwood Trace
rows.blurb: An old ranger cut peters out in briars.
